products.description:
STAR VIE HELION 2024 - Look for maximum precision on the track with the new Helion model. High control racket, round in shape and medium-low balance to achieve a defense game of 10. INTRODUCTION OF THE RACKET

STAR VIE HELION 2024, is the name of this racket. A new 2024 season model, which is intended for a control-based game. Its round shape and good comfort make it an ideal option for an intermediate level player.

PLAYER TYPE

This padel racket is highly recommended for a medium level player who plays in the defense zone.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We are going to analyze the characteristics of the STAR VIE HELION 2024, a padel racket designed to give you a perfect game from the defense zone, as it provides softness in hitting to increase control. It is made with Star Vie's Ultra Speed ​​Soft rubber, which is the softest rubber available in the brand.

Internally it has a hybrid composition in the tubular that combines carbon fiber and fiberglass. On the other hand, the planes are made of 100% fiberglass, but of different densities, which improves ball output and also durability.

It is a product 100% manufactured in Spain, specifically in the city of Guadalajara.

PLAY STYLE

If you are looking for a racket with which to dominate, this is one of the best padel rackets from the Spanish firm that you will be able to have. The STAR VIE HELION 2024 is a sure success in defense, also allowing a good attack.

products.title: Asics Gel Dedicate 9 Clay Independence Blue White 40 - Asics
products.description:
ASICS GEL DEDICATE 9 CLAY INDEPENDENCE BLUE WHITE - Zapatillas de pádel usadas para conseguir las mejores. 

 Las ASICS GEL DEDICATE 9 CLAY INDEPENDENCE BLUE WHITE son unas zapatillas de pádel pensadas para quienes buscan comodidad, estabilidad y buen agarre sin necesidad de pasar a los modelos más técnicos de ASICS.

Esta combinación en azul Independence Blue y blanco les da además un aspecto deportivo y muy fácil de combinar.

Uno de sus puntos fuertes es la tecnología GEL, situada en la zona delantera para amortiguar los impactos y conseguir apoyos más cómodos. Se agradece especialmente en las arrancadas, frenadas y movimientos continuos que hacemos durante un partido.

La estabilidad corre a cargo de TRUSSTIC, un refuerzo ligero en la zona media que aporta mayor firmeza y ayuda a que el pie se mantenga estable durante los desplazamientos.

Además, la suela Clay con dibujo de espiga proporciona un agarre seguro y permite controlar mejor los movimientos sobre tierra batida y superficies con arena.
products.englishTitle: Asics Gel Dedicate 9 Clay Independence Blue White 40 - Asics
products.englishDescription:
ASICS GEL DEDICATE 9 CLAY INDEPENDENCE BLUE WHITE - Used padel shoes to get the best ones. 

 The ASICS GEL DEDICATE 9 CLAY INDEPENDENCE BLUE WHITE are padel shoes designed for those looking for comfort, stability and good grip without having to upgrade to the more technical ASICS models.

This combination of Independence Blue and white also gives them a sporty look and is very easy to combine.

One of its strong points is the GEL technology, located in the front area to cushion impacts and achieve more comfortable support. It is especially appreciated in the starts, stops and continuous movements that we make during a match.

Stability is provided by TRUSSTIC, a light reinforcement in the middle area that provides greater firmness and helps the foot remain stable during movement.

In addition, the Clay sole with a herringbone pattern provides a secure grip and allows better control of movements on clay and sandy surfaces.
